name: critique
description: Critique ideas, plans, and decisions through independent thinking frames, one fresh subagent each, to counter agreeable answers.

interface.shortDescription: Critique an idea through independent thinking frames
interface.longDescription: Rewrites an idea, plan, decision, or situation as a neutral brief and sends it to one fresh subagent per thinking frame (pre-mortem, steelman for and against, outside view, second-order effects, incentives, alternatives, assumption audit, plus conditional frames). Shows every frame's verdict word for word and ends with one decision, kill conditions, and the cheapest next test. A quick mode runs three frames.
defaultPrompt: Critique this plan before I commit to it
Quick critique: should we move the team to async standups?
Pre-mortem this decision and poke holes in it
